description: Record a meeting via the Recordist app. If the person turned on 'Allow agents to start recordings' in Recordist (Settings, Integrations), the recording starts at once. Otherwise, the safe default, Recordist shows its own record card on the person's laptop and nothing records until they answer it; the result says which happened. Requires the app to be running.

source_app.description: zoom | teams | meet | slack | webex | facetime | manual (default manual)

title: Start recording
